tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, fields, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts: anything floating above the page. Always pair with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Search band, table heads, hover fills, chips, skeletons.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark slides, the loader scrim tint, the toast. Use text-on-inverse on it.

tokens.name: surface-feature
tokens.usage: Ground of the one feature card that leads a section. Lighter than surface-card in dark so it still stands out. Use text-on-inverse and text-on-inverse-muted on it (8.1:1 and 5.2:1 in dark).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on every surface above (12.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders, record labels on every surface (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings h1 and h2, the library name, panel titles.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links. Underline on hover; inside running text, always underlined.

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and pressed colour.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Copper text that must read on surface-band too: availability, alerts, active status rows (6.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (14.5:1).

tokens.name: text-on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse (8.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, nav links, eyebrows, icons. As text it reads on page and card, not on surface-band in light (4.0:1): use text-accent there.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill. Darker in light, lighter in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover fills (4.9:1 / 7.2:1 light, 7.1:1 / 9.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: action-on-feature
tokens.usage: Button fill and outline on surface-feature, where copper action is too dark (7.2:1 on navy-900 light, 5.8:1 on navy-700 dark). Used by the New arrivals stage.

tokens.name: action-on-feature-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for action-on-feature.

tokens.name: on-action-feature
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action-on-feature fill (7.2:1 / 9.4:1 light, 9.4:1 / 12:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-accent-on-feature
tokens.usage: Accent text and outline-button labels on surface-feature (9.4:1 on navy-900, 5.8:1 on navy-700).

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline and text; its hover fill.

tokens.name: on-action-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on an action-secondary fill (10.7:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: Decoration only: cover frame, bookcover ring, carousel dots, footer accent, the rosette watermark and the event date ring. 2.75:1 on cream, so never text and never the only cue for a state.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and lists, card edges. Decoration.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Rules under bands, table cell borders, pill outlines. Decoration.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders (3.05:1 light on page; 4.6:1 dark on card).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 3px focus outline on every interactive element (10:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: Fill of the Aljamea logo (the .aj-logo mask): heading blue in light (10:1 on the page), periwinkle in dark (9.6:1). Kept as its own token so the logo can be given a different colour later without touching headings.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Rosette artwork and accent text on surface-inverse only.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the page loader and modal content.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind drawers and dialogs (the filters drawer).

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a full-screen dialog that takes the reader's whole attention (New arrivals). The dimmed margin is also the click-away target.

groups.name: Display

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large single figures: the member's term count.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per page: page or record title. text-heading.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section and panel titles. text-heading.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings, card titles, footer column headings. text.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Record titles in Latin script in results, shelves and the record page. text-link.

styles.name: masthead-name
styles.usage: The library's name in the masthead. text-heading.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Masthead section links, menu items, tabs: anything you navigate by. text.

groups.note: DM Sans is variable with an optical-size axis: at heading sizes the browser picks its tighter display cut by itself (font-optical-sizing: auto). Hierarchy comes from weight, size and negative tracking, never from a second family.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside cards and dialogs. text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy, max 68ch per line. text.
styles.sample: Search by title, author or subject.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Toolbars, footer, record summaries, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, record field names, menu items.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Position in a sequence only (Step 2 of 4). Sentence case, never uppercase. action.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, counts, cover authors. The smallest size in the system (13px).

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: English title on printed covers. text-heading.

styles.name: cover-subtitle
styles.usage: Second line of a printed cover title.

styles.name: cover-tagline
styles.usage: Line in a cover's footer band. text-muted.

styles.name: rtl-h1
styles.usage: Page title on RTL pages (Tajawal). Never tracked or uppercased.

styles.name: rtl-h2
styles.usage: Section and panel titles.

styles.name: rtl-h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings and card titles.

styles.name: rtl-nav
styles.usage: Section links, menu items, tabs.

styles.name: rtl-passage
styles.usage: Quran, hadith and iqtibasaat on their own line. Set in Amiri, the only place outside search results that uses it.
styles.sample: مثلُ أهلِ بيتي فيكم كسفينةِ نوحٍ

styles.name: rtl-body
styles.usage: Default copy in Tajawal.
styles.sample: ابحث بالعنوان أو المؤلف أو الموضوع.

styles.name: rtl-body-sm
styles.usage: Toolbars, footer, summaries.

styles.name: rtl-label
styles.usage: Form labels, field names.

styles.name: rtl-button
styles.usage: Button labels.

styles.name: rtl-caption
styles.usage: The smallest Arabic size (14px).

styles.name: result-title-ar
styles.usage: Arabic and LSD titles and authors in search results, on English and Arabic pages alike. Kanz-al-Marjaan where installed (Apple devices), Amiri elsewhere (Amiri covers every LSD letter; Tajawal does not).
styles.sample: شرح الأخبار في فضائل الأئمة الأطهار

styles.name: result-author-ar
styles.usage: Arabic author names under a result title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, pills and toolbar items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Navbar vertical padding, menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field side padding, gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap between home panels, section spacing inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above the footer on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gutter on wide screens, login columns gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above the footer on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding at full width. In CSS: clamp(16px, 3.5vw, 48px).

size.note: Fixed sizes of controls and targets.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button and search field height.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons and selects. Hit area is padded to 44px.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Login fields and the full-width login button.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-logo-lg
tokens.usage: Logo height in the masthead's top tier.

tokens.name: size-logo
tokens.usage: Logo height in the navbar (40px under 700px).

tokens.name: size-logo-sm
tokens.usage: Logo height in the sticky masthead bar and under 700px wide.

tokens.name: size-cover-w
tokens.usage: Generated cover width in results; height is 1.5x.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for running text.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Book covers, images, skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Items inside menus (radius-md minus the 4px menu padding, so corners stay concentric).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, menus, cards, alerts, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Login card and the record action bar, the largest containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, chips, pager items, sort select.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Under the sticky navbar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card. Barely there in light; in dark a faint white ring gives the edge the fill step cannot.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Interactive card or cover on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: Book cover thumbnails at rest.

duration.note: Motion durations. Under prefers-reduced-motion, movement is removed and fades shorten to duration-instant.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press-down of a button or chip.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes, menu close, toast exit.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menu open, disclosure expand, tab indicator.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Toast enter, page transition, staggered entrance.

tokens.name: duration-loader
tokens.usage: One full cycle of the rosette loader: four petals draw, the disc fills, holds and clears.

easing.note: Motion curves. Enter with ease-out, leave with ease-in.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or responding to a press: menus, toasts, entrances.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: menu close, toast exit, old page in a transition.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Elements moving on screen: tab indicator, shelf scroll.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Button press and release.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar and record toolbar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-loader
tokens.usage: Page loader scrim.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Pair with cursor not-allowed and no press feedback.

tokens.name: opacity-skeleton
tokens.usage: Lowest point of the skeleton pulse.
